nodes.description: Constant maximum token supply of 100 used for the mint cap and starting index modulo.
Private mint price in wei (0.1 ether default) used to compute required msg.value.
Number of tokens reserved for owner claiming; subtracted from max supply and decremented on claim.
Public provenance hash string set by owner for artwork verification.
Pseudorandom starting index for the reveal; written in setStartingIndex.
Boolean gate controlling whether public minting is enabled.
Base URI prefix used by _baseURI for token metadata.
Hardcoded payout address receiving 75% of the withdraw balance.
Hardcoded payout address receiving 15% of the withdraw balance.
Hardcoded payout address receiving 10% of the withdraw balance.
External payable mint function gated by whenSaleStarted; validates amount, supply and payment then loops _safeMint to msg.sender.
onlyOwner toggle of _saleStarted that lazily triggers setStartingIndex on first start.
Public view returning the _saleStarted flag.
onlyOwner setter for the baseURI metadata prefix.
Internal override returning the configurable baseURI.
onlyOwner setter updating the mint price.
Public view returning the current mint price.
Public view returning remaining reserved token count.
onlyOwner setter for the provenance hash.
View helper enumerating all token IDs owned by a wallet via tokenOfOwnerByIndex.
onlyOwner function minting reserved tokens to a receiver and reducing _reserved.
Publicly callable function deriving startingIndex from block.difficulty, block.timestamp and blockhash; only runs when startingIndex is zero.
onlyOwner withdrawal splitting balance 75/15/10 and sending via address.send with require success.
Internal hook chain override delegating to ERC721 and ERC721Enumerable.
Public view interface support override chaining ERC721 and ERC721Enumerable.
Caller-controlled sender used as the mint recipient and access control subject.
Miner-influenceable timestamp fed into the starting index randomness derivation.
Origin address; not referenced in this contract but tracked as an untrusted input channel.
_safeMint invokes IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient, an external callback enabling reentrancy.
payable(...).send forwards only 2300 gas and can fail silently/revert, risking locked funds during withdraw.
Weak on-chain randomness from block.difficulty, block.timestamp and blockhash is predictable and miner/caller manipulable.
Caller-supplied number of tokens to mint in mint(uint256 _nbTokens).
Local variable caching totalSupply() used for token id computation in mint.
Owner-supplied count of reserved tokens to mint in claimReserved.
Recipient address for reserved token mints in claimReserved.
Local derived block offset computed from difficulty/timestamp in setStartingIndex.
Local past block reference used for blockhash lookup in setStartingIndex.
Local payout amount computed from balance in withdraw.
Local copy of contract balance read before splitting in withdraw.
Wallet address passed to walletOfOwner for enumeration.
Owner-supplied new price value passed to setPrice.

edges.reason: mint reads _price to compute the required payment (_nbTokens * _price).
mint reads maxSupply to enforce the supply cap.
mint reads _reserved to bound the mintable supply.
flipSaleStarted writes the _saleStarted flag.
flipSaleStarted checks/writes startingIndex when starting the sale.
flipSaleStarted calls setStartingIndex on first sale start.
whenSaleStarted modifier gates mint on the _saleStarted state variable.
setBaseURI writes the baseURI state variable.
_baseURI reads and returns the baseURI state variable.
setPrice writes the _price state variable.
getPrice reads the _price state variable.
getReservedLeft reads the _reserved state variable.
setProvenanceHash writes HAR_PROVENANCE.
saleStarted reads the _saleStarted flag.
claimReserved reads and decrements _reserved.
claimReserved calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on _receiver before finishing the _reserved update, enabling reentrancy.
mint calls _safeMint on msg.sender, invoking the receiver callback mid-loop and allowing reentrant mint calls.
msg.sender is used as the recipient of minted tokens in mint.
msg.sender-driven callers reach withdrawal paths protected only by onlyOwner; captured for access-control tracking.
block.timestamp feeds the starting index randomness, a timestamp-dependency weakness in the public setStartingIndex.
setStartingIndex uses block.difficulty/blockhash as weak, manipulable randomness.
Predictable blockhash randomness determines startingIndex, allowing a caller to front-run for a favorable reveal.
setStartingIndex writes the computed value into startingIndex.
withdraw performs external address.send payments to hardcoded recipients.
withdraw sends the 75% split to the Ines address.
withdraw sends the 15% split to the InesM address.
withdraw sends the 10% split to the Harems address.
_nbTokens parameter controls the mint loop and payment computation in mint.
supply local variable drives token id computation in the mint loop.
_number parameter controls the reserved mint loop in claimReserved.
_receiver parameter is the recipient of reserved mints in claimReserved.
_receiver is passed into _safeMint so the receiver callback executes on attacker-influenced code.
_block_shift local variable carries the derived randomness offset in setStartingIndex.
_block_ref local variable is used for the blockhash lookup in setStartingIndex.
_split local variable carries the computed payout to the send call in withdraw.
_balance local variable is the source of the split computations in withdraw.
_owner parameter is queried by walletOfOwner for balance and enumeration.
_newPrice parameter is written into the _price state variable by setPrice.

normalization_plan.reason: _nbTokens is the sole uint256 parameter consumed only inside mint; it has no independent behavior and can be folded into the mint core function.
supply is a purely local cache of totalSupply() used only within mint and should be normalized into mint.
_number is a parameter used only by claimReserved to bound its mint loop and can be merged into that function.
_receiver is a parameter used only by claimReserved as the _safeMint recipient.
_block_shift is a transient local in setStartingIndex feeding the blockhash computation.
_block_ref is a transient local in setStartingIndex used for the blockhash lookup.
_split is a local payout value used only within withdraw.
_balance is a local snapshot of the contract balance used only within withdraw.
_owner is a parameter consumed only by walletOfOwner for enumeration.
_newPrice is a parameter used only to overwrite _price inside setPrice.
